Course summary

Written Communication Skills Training

Duration
Full day

Discuss this course

Improve the clarity, impact and professionalism of your written communication.

You leave with

  • Confidence and capability in: structuring written documents for impact
  • Confidence and capability in: writing clearly and concisely
  • Confidence and capability in: email etiquette and best practice
  • Confidence and capability in: adapting your style for different audiences
  • Confidence and capability in: proofreading and editing techniques

On the agenda

  1. Structuring written documents for impact
  2. Writing clearly and concisely
  3. Email etiquette and best practice
  4. Adapting your style for different audiences
  5. Proofreading and editing techniques
